result: Adam reaches ε-stationary points with O(ε⁻⁴) stochastic gradients without assuming bounded gradients or global smoothness: curvature may grow like L0 + Lρ‖∇f‖^ρ, ρ < 2, and the proof shows gradients stay bounded along Adam's trajectory (variance-reduced variant: O(ε⁻³)).
result_plain: Adam converges (O(ε⁻⁴)) under curvature growing sub-quadratically with the gradient norm.
